limits: Only original recorded browser durations contribute; this audit host acquires no timing.
Every missing/failed report remains an ordered row. A partial cohort cannot qualify or be replaced.
Strict original semantic/memory/activation failures remain disqualifying even when faithfully reproduced.
Each host is reported separately without pooling, subtraction, trimming, replacement or threshold tuning.
The optional development-package hash is bound as recorded provenance; actual Chrome runtime packages receive complete member verification.
Component qualification is only a prerequisite and does not substitute for complete browser-import gains.

limitations: Non-atomic sampled observations; short-lived processes and unsampled memory changes can be missed.
Only complete scans wholly inside the marked automation import window contribute to maxima.
Markers bracket dispatch through visible completion and include automation overhead, not readback or restart.
PSS apportions shared mappings; private bytes are reported separately. Neither is an exact peak measurement.
All failed and boundary scans are retained; no missing read is assigned a measured zero.
